description: Explicit NHFLOW (SSP-RK2, A 520 2) with the fourth-order horizontal operators of the projection (A 508 1) and the consistent bed node (A 522 0): Beji & Battjes bar (Benchmark nhflow_beji_battjes_bar), 750 cells, 4 sigma layers, relaxation zones. 800 steps: the waves reach the bar crest.
covers: nhflow_pjm_ho: divx at the pressure nodes and the bed node on a sloping bed, gradx of the pressure increment and of the old pressure (nhflow_pjm_corr::rhs, ucorr, upgrad)
second-order fallback next to the open boundaries
